issues.detail: The Greek 'ου μη καταλυθη' is a double negative (ou + mē), which translates to 'that will NOT be destroyed/overthrown'. The Vietnamese translation 'mà không bị đổ xuống' (but not be fallen) combined with the preceding 'Sẽ không còn...' creates a confusing double negative or a logic error. In Greek, Jesus is saying: 'Do you see these great buildings? [Which are such that] no stone will be laid on stone without being destroyed.' The Vietnamese phrasing suggests the stones *won't* fall, which is the opposite of the intended meaning.
